specific_waiting.value: 1 year (benign ENT, tonsillectomy etc.), 2 years (cataract, hernia, diabetes, hypertension and others), 4 years (joint replacement, osteoarthritis)

initial_waiting.value: 30 days, does not apply to accidents

room_rent.value: 1% of sum insured per day, max ₹5,000; ICU 2% per day, max ₹10,000; 25% of sum insured per illness

renewal.value: By mutual consent; cannot be denied except for fraud, moral hazard, misrepresentation or non cooperation; 30 day grace period
